data.description:
## What
Two deliverables for story 6721-1e3a.

### Deliverable 1: review-stats.sh — expose 4 metrics in CLI output
The 4 Python metric functions (compute_p90_cycle_count, compute_phantom_escalation_rate, compute_prior_region_resustain_skew, compute_call2_finding_drop_rate) are added to review-stats.py by story 7c6f-a6c1 (task f664-48c3). This task ensures review-stats.sh exposes them in its output via the thin wrapper.

Add --window flag support if not already present: --window=7d (default) | --window=30d
The 4 metrics must appear in the JSON output from review-stats.sh when it calls review-stats.py.

### Deliverable 2: docs/designs/review-stats-playbook.md (new)
Create response playbook documenting:

| Metric | Alert threshold | Response action |
|--------|----------------|-----------------|
| phantom_escalation_rate | >15% for 2 consecutive 7-day windows | Open P2 bug against cycle-1 severity rubric |
| prior_region_resustain_skew | >20% for 2 consecutive 7-day windows | Open P2 bug against two-call architecture / prior_findings_index |
| p90_cycle_count | >3 for 2 consecutive 7-day windows | Audit recent PRs for cycle-inflation patterns |
| call2_finding_drop_rate | >10% | Open P2 bug against Call 2 completeness check logic |

Note: threshold values are advisory until first 30-day data window establishes baselines.

## Files to Modify/Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/review-stats.sh (add --window flag or verify 4 metrics flow through)
- docs/designs/review-stats-playbook.md (new playbook doc)

## Acceptance Criteria
- review-stats.sh --help mentions the 4 metric names OR outputs them in JSON
- test -f docs/designs/review-stats-playbook.md
- docs/designs/review-stats-playbook.md contains all 4 metric names and alert thresholds

## Testing Mode
GREEN (metrics wiring) + UPDATE (playbook doc — test-exempt: documentation artifact)

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/review-stats.sh (modify)
- docs/designs/review-stats-playbook.md (create)
data.title: GREEN: review-stats.sh — expose 4 new metrics; docs/review-stats-playbook.md — response playbook
